mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8%, indicating a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 8%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and rising housing starts (HOUST) signals a supply-side boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during supply-side booms are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real disposable income (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a month indicates reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5%, indicating a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declining payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a labor market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns during labor market downturns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3% for 2 quarters, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
